decisions.reason: After four years with no later observed website presence, this multi-model formwork line has largely revealed its prospects, and the option value no longer justifies carrying the range.

This automation-related control remains closely aligned with the firm's strategic push into integrated factory automation and can still be retained as a relatively low-cost option within system projects.
As a close-to-core shuttering accessory that is likely inexpensive to offer and complements the installed base, it is still worth keeping available.

Its limited visibility, likely overlap with other magnetic formwork items, and the time elapsed since launch suggest that resources are better redeployed to stronger core products and new development.
